name: Dynamic Multi-Frame Rate Rendering
aliases: Dynamic single and multi-frame rate rendering
definition: A rendering system that dynamically switches between multi-frame rate rendering (using image-based warping for low latency) and single-frame rate parallel raycasting (using all GPUs for high quality) based on current workload complexity.
summary: Dynamic Multi-Frame Rate Rendering is a hybrid system that dynamically switches between low-latency multi-frame rate rendering and high-quality single-frame rate parallel raycasting based on workload complexity.
